Any REPL can be used as a "shell". For Python, set the prompt to match `>>>`:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: python3
    shell-args: ["-q"]
    prompt: ">>>"
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
import sys
print(f"Hello from Python {sys.version.split()[0]}")
```

## List Comprehensions

```{term}
squares = [x**2 for x in range(1, 11)]
print(squares)
```

## Dictionaries

```{term}
data = {"name": "quarto-term", "version": "0.1.0", "shells": 6}
for key, value in data.items():
    print(f"  {key}: {value}")
```

## Multi-Line Expressions

```{term}
def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a

[fibonacci(i) for i in range(10)]
```
